svg.aria-label: Consumer-side channel state today is spread over the source, the exchange queue and the client; in the new design the ending state is one state per source inside UcxExchangeQueue.
svg.text: UcxExchangeSource
one per remote task · atomics and plain bools
UcxExchangeQueue
shared by all sources of one client · UcxExchangeQueue.mutex_
UcxExchangeClient
one per exchange node of the consumer task
Intra-node fields
out of scope: removed in a separate change
UcxExchangeSource
UCX progress only · reports every end through end(outcome)

text.tspan: one call replaces the four paths

svg.text: UcxExchangeQueue
UcxExchangeQueue.lock (today's mutex_) · one state per source
STATE PER SOURCE (inside UcxExchangeQueue, no lock of its own)
VIEWS OVER THE SOURCE STATES

text.tspan: any source Ended with an error
or close are freed after unlock

svg.text: UcxExchangeClient
close() releases the sources' states in UcxExchangeQueue
Intra-node fields
out of scope: removed in a separate change
replaced by the protocol version
stays
moves into UcxExchangeQueue
removed; close() releases states
